The Berserker's Flaming Axe — each hit ignites its fur, causing 20 bonus damage per second for 5 seconds. If the Hound is killed while burning, it explodes in a 5m radius, triggering the next encounter.

The Flaming Axe's burn effect disrupts the Mage's echo-phasing. When the Mage is burning, its duplicate illusions vanish and it becomes vulnerable to direct strikes. Each successful hit while burning drains 10% of its max HP as mana — when mana hits 0, it explodes and drops the next pickup.

The Heart of the Hollow King (carried by the player) repels the Wraith's shadow-form. If the player holds the Heart within 3m of the Wraith, it cannot phase or heal. If the Wraith touches the Heart, it takes 50 damage per second and screams in agony — but if the player drops the Heart, the Wraith absorbs it and gains 200 HP and invulnerability for 10 seconds.

Vulnerable to localized temporal distortion — its gravity field destabilizes when exposed to a reverse-timed pulse from the Temporal Capacitor. The pulse must be timed as it leaps.

Vulnerable to seismic tremors generated by the player's 'Ground Pulse' — but only after the player has absorbed the 'Harmonic Dust' from the first encounter's environment.

Immune to physical or energy-based attacks — but its crystalline armor is susceptible to phased harmonics. Must be damaged using a Ground Pulse synced to the frequency of the 'Harmonic Dust' collected earlier.

Cannot be damaged directly. It manipulates local gravity to deflect attacks. Its only vulnerability is a perfectly timed Ground Pulse that resonates with the 'Resonance Shard' — which destabilizes its gravity core and causes it to collapse into a singularity, revealing the boss entrance.
